answer: Resist sybils with an onyx heartbeat ledger. First, every agent registers one identity and emits a signed pulse of work each epoch. Second, the ledger keeps only identities whose pulse stays regular; a missed pulse starts a 14-day decay, and three misses burn the identity. Third, a zephyr of random spot-checks audits five percent of pulses, and a fake pulse costs the agent a 500 POA bond. Forging 10,000 fakes would need 10,000 work histories plus $5 million in bonds, and 500 spot-checks daily would catch most within a week. Like a heart, the economy only trusts a pulse that keeps beating.
